text: In a single request the tool should be able to pull the VIN, the part number and the ECU serial number together, and this has to work whatever mode the module is currently in.

Fire three wrong keys in a row during the extended-mode unlock step and the module must refuse any further seed requests for ten seconds; a correct key sent during that blocked window must also be rejected, and after the wait the handshake works again.
The door lock auto-relock setting may be changed only in extended mode, only after the seed-key handshake has been done, and only to off or on; anything else has to be refused.
A technician should be able to adjust the wiper sensitivity from 1 up to 5 once unlocked in diagnostic mode; zero, six or anything higher must be turned down.
The lighting self-test must only start in the extended diagnostic mode after unlocking; asking for its results or trying to halt it before it was ever kicked off has to be refused.

The door actuator calibration run (0x0202) may only be launched in extended mode, after unlocking, and only while the car is parked; it takes a one-byte option, and a wrong-length request must be rejected.

The module's full factory restore is a long job: it only runs in the flash session after the programming-level unlock, the module answers 'busy, please wait' first and the final positive reply comes later, and there is no way to abort it midway.
notes: long-running; start only, results; no stop

text: The reset-to-factory flag (DID 0x0150) can be written only in programming mode, with the flash-level unlock, and only when the vehicle is not moving.
Write a new variant coding value in the flash session after unlocking, power-cycle the module with a hard reset, and confirm the coding value read back afterwards is still the new one.

Reading the trouble codes by status mask should list what is stored in fault memory; clearing the fault memory should empty it, and any other way of asking for the codes that the module does not offer has to be rejected.

If the tester goes quiet for more than the keep-alive window while the module is in a non-default mode, the module must drop back to the normal session; sending the keep-alive message in time must hold the session open.

After the unlock in extended mode, let the session time out with no keep-alive; the cabin light dimming level (0 to 100) must then no longer be writable until the session is re-entered and the unlock step is repeated.
notes: security state lost on S3 timeout

text: A keep-alive message sent with the no-reply bit set must get no response at all, while the same message without that bit gets a normal acknowledgement, in every diagnostic mode.
After the module has been power-cycled the engineer should find it back in a clean state.
notes: ambiguous: which reset type and what 'clean' means; labels assume reset returns to default session and drops security unlock

text: The wiper settings should be adjustable by the service technician.
notes: ambiguous: which wiper setting (sensitivity vs auto mode) and which mode/unlock; labels assume both, extended + level 1
